items.headline: Centrus and Oklo finalise HALEU purchase agreements for Ohio Aurora campus
items.what_happened: Centrus and Oklo finalised definitive purchase agreements for HALEU, following their June 2026 letter of intent. Fuel from Centrus's American Centrifuge Plant in Pike County, Ohio would power up to five Aurora powerhouses at Oklo's planned 1.2 GW Ohio campus for Meta, with deliveries scheduled to begin in 2029. Oklo will make prepayments for future HALEU deliveries.
items.why_it_matters: For a 1-20 MW buyer this is a fuel-supply contract for a 1.2 GW campus, not a microreactor order. It shows HALEU supply for advanced reactors moving from letter of intent to signed purchase agreement, with first deliveries in 2029.
items.binding_note: Definitive purchase agreements, per the WNN article dated 2026-11-13. The article gives no signing date, and the Centrus release could not be fetched (HTTP 403), so the 2026-11-13 date is the article date.
